detail: Full summary: lane 02b added twining_exchange_status to the shared command registry but never registered it as an MCP tool — src/tools/ had no exchange-tools.ts and src/server.ts had no call. Caught only by the registry↔MCP parity test. Every future lane that adds a command must add BOTH the registry entry and the src/tools registration loop, plus the collectTools() line in test/core/command-registry.test.ts.
